bridgeRouteRisk.summary: The September 2026 SICAV prospectus identifies all eight networks as issuer-maintained share registers and lets investors choose their register network at subscription; the exact CHF API binds every catalog address to ISIN FR0014015LG6 and five share decimals. These are independently issued native fund-share liabilities, not receipts minted against canonical CHFSAFO locked on another chain. Spiko's documented direct issuer mint/redemption-burn architecture and shareholder-register terms support transfer-census eligibility without a cross-chain escrow plan. A same-register redemption queue holds shares pending burn; it is not bridge lock/release backing. Current cross-register administrator state, transfer conservation and material supply still require their own evidence and runtime census.
